pages.text: The layered stones and a few common blocks are crushed too. Chances are per block:$(br2)$(li)$(item)Bauxite$(): 75%% chance of 2 bauxite powder, plus 20%% chance of 1 more.

$(li)$(item)Galena$(): 40%% chance of 1 crushed raw lead, 10%% chance of 2 lead nuggets.$(li)$(item)Lignite$(): 75%% chance of 1 coal, plus 20%% chance of 1 more.$(li)$(item)Sulfur$(): 20%% chance of 1 sulfur dust, plus 10%% chance of 1 more.$(li)$(item)Limestone$() (Create): always 1 $(item)limesand$().
$(li)$(item)Dirt$(): 5%% chance of 1 $(item)nitrate dust$() (saltpeter). Crush dirt in bulk.

Limestone is not found in the world: Create makes it where $(item)honey meets flowing lava$() (a lava source gives obsidian instead). A small honey and lava generator next to a mechanical drill gives you all the limesand you need.
Sulfur dust is slow to collect, so start crushing sulfur early. Bauxite powder becomes aluminium later, nitrate and sulfur dust become gunpowder and sulfuric acid.
